name: huddle
description: Channels where AI coding sessions and their subagents work as one team: shared events, tasks with cross-session dependencies, pause/resume, messages and shared knowledge.

scripts.connect: bun -e "const s=await Bun.file('plugin/skills/huddle/SKILL.md').text(); await Bun.write('plugin/server/CONNECT.md', '<!-- generated from plugin/skills/huddle/SKILL.md by bun run connect: edit the skill -->\n' + s.replace(/^---[\\s\\S]*?\\n---\\n\\n?/, ''))"
